data.title: Logistics & Distribution
data.tagline: Throughput that holds under peak, with inventory you can actually see.
data.overview: Distribution operations succeed or fail at the seams: inbound receipt, put-away, picking, dispatch, and reconciliation. We engineer those seams so peak volume does not turn into permanent improvisation.

challenges.title: Peak variability
challenges.description: Seasonal volume exposes labour, dock, and conveyor constraints.

challenges.title: Manual reconciliation
challenges.description: Inventory accuracy depends on nightly correction cycles.

challenges.title: Space constraints
challenges.description: Growth requires denser storage without slowing picking.

solutions.title: Industrial Software
solutions.tagline: Operational platforms that turn machine data into decisions.
solutions.overview: We build focused operational software where off-the-shelf tools stop short: production portals, quality workflows, asset registers, and integration layers. Every interface is designed for the shift, not for a demo.

solutions.title: Digital Transformation
solutions.tagline: A practical route from fragmented systems to a connected operation.
solutions.overview: Transformation fails when it starts with technology. We help leadership sequence change around a clear operating problem, then deliver the data, systems, and habits that make the change durable.

solutions.title: System Integration
solutions.tagline: One accountable team across vendors, protocols, and sites.
solutions.overview: We take responsibility for the seams. Meridian coordinates vendors, designs the integration layer, tests the whole system, and stays accountable when something does not behave as specified.

related_projects.summary: A Laem Chabang container terminal connected gate, yard, and crane data so peak planning started before the queue formed.
